paragraphs.text:
You  think  of  Sylvia’s  keen  intellect,  her  loyalty,  and  her 
persistence  despite  the  doom  that  has  seemed  to  dog  this 
expedition. While life remains within her, you cannot abandon 
her to these creatures. You lead her by hand through the camp 
of sleeping sasquatches.

Make  a  Stealth  roll  for  every  party  member.  Sylvia’s  Stealth  is 
currently 15%. If everyone succeeds, go to 357. If anyone misses, go 
to 390.
